controls.name: with-coalesce-typed
controls.classification: decision K1: a WITH coalesce column read through CY_TYPED like RETURN coalesce (R259 extended)

controls.name: coalesce-cast-gone
controls.classification: decision K2: the WITH stage's CAST to VARCHAR removed (the raw IRIS number reaches the driver)

controls.name: driver-541-native
controls.classification: provider P-DRV-NUM: driver 5.4.1 assumed to hand a raw IRIS number to Python as a number

controls.name: no-mark-decode
controls.classification: decoder D1: read_prop_value no longer decodes CY_TYPED's mark

controls.name: no-prop-text
controls.find: pub open spec fn prop_text_col(s: Shape) -> bool { reads_node_value(s) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn prop_text_col(s: Shape) -> bool { false }
controls.classification: decision: no column is in prop_text_expr_columns (a stored boolean stays 'true')

controls.name: case-prop-text
controls.find: pub open spec fn prop_text_col(s: Shape) -> bool { reads_node_value(s) }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn prop_text_col(s: Shape) -> bool { reads_node_value(s) || is_case(s) }
controls.classification: decision: CASE columns put in prop_text_expr_columns (the bool half of the repair)

controls.name: bool-text-ignored
controls.classification: decoder D2: parse_prop_text does not read 'true'/'false'

controls.name: bool-expr-off
controls.find: pub open spec fn bool_expr_col() -> bool { true }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn bool_expr_col() -> bool { false }
controls.classification: decision K3: a comparison column not in bool_expr_columns (answers 1/0)

controls.name: gt-text-zero
controls.find: match st { Stored::Native(n) => DV::Bit(if tenths(n) > c { 1 } else { 0 }), _ => DV::Null }
controls.replace: match st { Stored::Native(n) => DV::Bit(if tenths(n) > c { 1 } else { 0 }), _ => DV::Bit(0) }
controls.classification: SQL: a comparison over no value or text answers false instead of null

controls.name: missing-not-null
controls.classification: SQL: a missing property read as '' instead of NULL

controls.name: labels-null
controls.classification: decision K4: the unbound node's labels column null (the repair of bug-plt-135)

controls.classification: decision K1 (_is_typed_coalesce): a RETURN coalesce item no longer typed

controls.name: with-prop-untyped
controls.classification: decision K1 (_is_node_value_var): a WITH variable bound to a bare property no longer typed
